sloka: न्यपातयत तेजस्वी चतुरः तस्य वाजिनः ।अष्टभिः सायकैः सूतम् रथ उपस्थे न्यपातयत् ॥३-२७-१५॥
transliteration: nyapātayata tejasvī caturaḥ tasya vājinaḥ ।aṣṭabhiḥ sāyakaiḥ sūtam ratha upasthe nyapātayat ॥3-27-15॥

translations.english: Rama brought down the charioteer with eight arrows and with one tore down the lofty banner of the chariot to shreds.
